main_body: Wooden chair seen from the front with a tall slatted backrest above a narrow seat and two legs
top_band: Light orange seat band at about rows 8-9 (2 rows), directly under a tall backrest face. No separate top surface is visible above it.
evidence: The backrest is a large vertical face (rows 3-7) that hides the seat. The seat reads as a thin 2-row band, like the red 'thin seat band 2' in the guide, not the 5-row top of the green seat. There is no distinct front-edge line and no shadow under the seat. The legs below are plain vertical strips. The seat surface cannot be read from above, so this is front elevation.

style.evidence: The chair has only about 3 orange wood tones, from light seat to mid orange to dark brown. The outline is a dark brown-black that leans close to neutral on the left edge. The backrest and seat have little grain or texture, so they read as flat fills. Each tile carries only a few colours, well below the stall and well references, which have scalloped, speckled and multi-step surfaces.
